历史记录跟着自己的台站，不跟着当前台站变: History records belong to their own station, not to the current one
呼号 / 网格规整成大写: Callsigns / grid squares normalised to upper case
当前台站仍是用户自己那条: The current station is still the user's own record
当前台站仍然有效就不动: If the current station is still valid, leave it alone
当前台站要落到还在的那条: The current station must land on the record that still exists
撞车的 id 必须换成没被占用的: A colliding id must be replaced with an unoccupied one
撞车的与归零的都要换新 id: Both colliding and zeroed ids must get new ones
操作员只是去空白，不改大小写: The operator field is only trimmed, case unchanged
最后一条不许删: The last record must not be deleted
档案名为空时回落到呼号: When the profile name is empty it falls back to the callsign
迁移不做大小写改写，原样搬过来: Migration does not rewrite case; it copies as is
迁移来的那条还在: The migrated record is still there
